_note: Seasons (war-and-realm §9; owner spec 2026-10-07, Part B). PLACEHOLDER numbers. core/seasons.gd generates one campaign's seasons from its seed: summers last summer[0]-summer[1] turns, winters winter[0]-winter[1] (a long winter of 3 turns is rare: long_winter_chance); forecasts come forecast[0]-forecast[1] turns ahead from the culture's seers.

effects._note: Summer: food x summer_food. Winter: food x by latitude, from north_food at the map's north edge to south_food at its south edge (north_band: the share of the map counted as north, where it is coldest); dry climates (desert, redrock, jungle, steppe) get a dry season instead: food x dry_food, no snow. Supply in enemy land drains x winter_supply. Snow slows movement: an army in the north band or on hills, passes or mountains refills only winter_move of its movement points. The map whitens progressively: snow_ramp turns to full cover.

seers._note: Who forecasts the winter, by culture (the event names them).
